title: BlueBlocks: HIPAA Risk Assessment & BAA Templates
description:
Create formal HIPAA risk assessment and Business Associate Agreement templates.

## Compliance Requirements

### Risk Assessment (§164.308(a)(1))
- Identify all systems handling PHI
- Document potential threats and vulnerabilities
- Assess likelihood and impact
- Document current safeguards
- Determine residual risk

### BAA Templates Needed
1. Cloud provider BAA (AWS/OCI)
2. Healthcare partner BAA
3. Third-party service BAA

## HIPAA Gaps Identified
- No formal risk assessment document
- No BAA templates
- No breach notification procedures
- No privacy notice
